when SERVER_CONNECTED {
    # Set the rate to 1Mbps (125,000 bytes per second)
    log local0. "UDP set max rate: [UDP::max_rate 125000]"
    log local0. "UDP get max rate: [UDP::max_rate]"
    # Enable printing debug messages.
    log local0. "Enable debugging [UDP::debug_queue enable]"
}

text:
UDP::debug_queue
Description
This command can be used to enable/disable printing debug messages
when UDP::max_rate iRule is in use.
Syntax
UDP
::
debug_queue
<
enable
|
disable
>
Examples
when
SERVER_CONNECTED
{
# Set the rate to 1Mbps (125,000 bytes per second)
log
local0.
"UDP set max rate: [UDP::max_rate 125000]"
log
local0.
"UDP get max rate: [UDP::max_rate]"
# Enable printing debug messages.
log
local0.
"Enable debugging [UDP::debug_queue enable]"
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANY
